items.q: Will the hooks make my reels go viral?
items.a: No tool can promise that. A strong hook helps people stop scrolling, and the rest of the reel still has to deliver.

items.q: How long should my reel be?
items.a: Fifteen to thirty seconds suits most tips and offers. The tool supports 15 to 60 second scripts.

items.q: Is the reel script writer free?
items.a: Yes. The Reel hook and script writer is free to use as often as you like, with no sign-up or login.

items.q: Can your team script, shoot and edit reels for us?
items.a: Yes. Our social media team plans hooks, shoots in monthly batches and edits with subtitles.
